MUS.note: The Blueprint plans a single citizen data hub and names cloud infrastructure as a catalyst, but the document states no rule, hosting or goal on keeping state data under national control.
The document says nothing on local government offices or their connection.
Mobile ID is named only as a Blueprint pillar to be adopted, a plan with no service stated.
The article promises a stronger legal framework and mentions a data protection officer duty without naming a law or its standing.
The article states no count of online services, portal or use figure.
The article describes a planned data hub and data scattered over some twenty databases, with no register keyed on the national ID.
The article states no public criticism by a named group, no cut and no punishment.
